data.title: AI-assisted staging draws boos at the Richard Wagner festival in Germany
data.description: An experiment with artificial intelligence at the annual Richard Wagner festival in the German town of Bayreuth has drawn boos from the audience after producing a staging that appeared to leave some spectators confused.
data.keywords: Fairs and festivals, Richard Wagner, Marcus Lobbes, Christian Thielemann, Artificial intelligence, General news, Technology, World news, Entertainment, Germany
